subject: Uplift addendum & single-invoice plan 1 procurement redline review
messages:
From: John Daly <john.daly@novaworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novaworks.com
Date: 2027-09-15T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: New capacity uplift / term question

Tessa 1 thanks again for the demo. Quick follow from procurement: we want to add 750k token-equivalent capacity for the new feature, and would like the incremental capacity to be on a 24-month term while the base subscription remains on the existing 12-month cycle. Procurement prefers a single signed package and a single invoice each month.

Two specific asks from GC/procurement:
1) Can the 24-month commitment start on provisioning (so its not backdated)? GC is concerned about revenue recognition mismatch.
2) Can Redwood include a brief clause that gives NovaWorks priority access to the uplifted units for the first 6 months (were not asking for hard SLA changes, but want a commitment to capacity prioritization).

Target: sign paperwork by Sep 24 so engineering can kick off provisioning Sep 27. Im attaching our procurement redlines.

Attachments: novaworks_order_v3.pdf (current order), nova_msa_gc_redlines.docx (redlines)

Thanks,
John
Director, Product Ops
NovaWorks

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: John Daly <john.daly@novaworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-15T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New capacity uplift / term question

John 1 appreciate the clear asks. We can get you a signable package that keeps things to a single signed addendum + consolidated order bundle (one invoice flow). High-level answers:
- Start date: wel set the 24-month clock to the provisioning date (we agree that avoids backdating).
- Priority access: we can offer a six-month "soft priority" commitment (routing preference and pre-warming) but need to avoid changing our SLA or promising absolute capacity reservation.
- Onboarding credit: if provisioning slips beyond the target date we can include a one-time credit to offset delay; wel show a proposed credit band in the addendum.

Ben will draft the addendum and consolidated order bundle today and circulate redlines. Can you confirm the exact token units and the billing cadence (monthly or quarterly)?

—Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: procurement@novaworks.com <procurement@novaworks.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: John Daly <john.daly@novaworks.com>
Date: 2027-09-16T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New capacity uplift / term question - redlines attached

Tessa 1 GC attached a short redline to the MSA and a few comments on the order form. Key items they flagged:
- Effective date: must be tied to provisioning and explicitly disallow retroactive effective dates.
- Priority access: acceptable only if framed as "routing preference" and limited to six months; GC asks for monitoring language (reporting if preference not honored).
- Billing: request a single invoice combining base and uplift with clear proration lines.

(Attachment: nova_msa_gc_redlines.docx)

If you can mirror those terms in an addendum + consolidated order bundle we can move fast.

procurement@novaworks.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-17T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Draft addendum / recommended redlines

Team 1 Ive attached a first-pass addendum and an updated order bundle. My recommended stance: accept provisioning start date language; accept "routing preference" phrasing for the 6-month priority but add a reporting obligation (we provide monthly utilization and routing logs upon request, limited to five reports). Push back on any language that implies guaranteed capacity or modifies SLA metrics. For the one-time credit, propose a fixed USD 5,000 credit tied to a provisioning miss beyond 10 business days.

Two legal points for Markus: please confirm revenue recognition exposure with finance if we set start date at provisioning and allow proration in the order bundle. Also, confirm DocuSign workflow for a combined addendum + order.

(Attachment: proposed_addendum_v1.docx, redwood_uplift_playbook_v2.pdf)

—Ben

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-17T12:40:00-07:00
Subject: Revenue recognition note + legal tweaks

Ben 1 quick notes after finance looked at the draft: starting the 24-month term on provisioning is the cleanest approach; revenue recognition impact is limited if we invoice monthly and recognize over the committed period. Finance flagged we should avoid any retroactive credits that could create revenue restatements. For the priority reporting, add a limit: NovaWorks can request up to five routing/usage reports in the six-month window.

I also recommend tightening the addendum language on "routing preference" so its non-binding operational guidance and not an SLA change. Small redlines inline in the draft.

—Markus

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: John Daly <john.daly@novaworks.com>, procurement@novaworks.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Final addendum proposal & sign path

John / procurement team 1 thanks for the fast turnaround. Attached is a clean addendum that: (1) sets the 24-month uplift term to begin on provisioning, (2) consolidates base + uplift into a single Order Bundle (OrderForm v4) with proration lines to ensure one invoice, (3) describes a six-month "routing preference" (non-SLA) with up to five monthly routing/usage reports available on request, and (4) offers a one-time USD 5,000 onboarding credit if provisioning is delayed beyond Sep 27 by more than 10 business days.

If that looks good we will prepare DocuSign envelope (addendum + OrderForm v4) for signature. Target send: Sep 22; target execute: Sep 24.

(Attachments: proposed_addendum_v1.docx, redwood_uplift_playbook_v2.pdf, novaworks_order_v4_draft.pdf)

Thanks,
Tessa
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
